concept.title: Egypt *as a stage.*
concept.subtitle: Three settings for a CRUSH evening where art, music and a luxury brand meet, with NOYA running every element on the ground.
concept.lead: CRUSH brings brands and artists together, Cartier with Gloria Gaynor, IWC with Jamiroquai, in moments people remember. Egypt offers settings few cities can match. NOYA makes them work on the day.
concept.quote: One evening, built for a brand's closest clients, in a place they have never been hosted before.
concept.why_title: A new chapter for luxury in Egypt.

why.label: Talent
why.text: ICONS. by CRUSH brings the artists and cultural figures. NOYA brings the setting, the hospitality and the logistics.

options.title: Dinner facing the Pyramids
options.text: A seated dinner for a brand's top clients, set so the Pyramids are the backdrop at sunset, followed by a live performance from an artist of CRUSH's choosing.
meta: Venue, permits, staging partners, catering, guest transport

options.title: An evening among antiquities
options.text: A reception and dinner at Egypt's newest cultural landmark, with a contemporary artist collaboration in conversation with the collection.
meta: Venue liaison, permits, hospitality, guest journey

options.title: A long table by the sea
options.text: Two days on the Red Sea: arrival by yacht, a long-table dinner on the beach and an intimate performance after dinner.
meta: Hotels, yachts, beach venue, transfers, security

email.subject: Re: NOYA x CRUSH Agency — Egypt production support
paragraphs: On your earlier question: the clearest way to show how we work is a concrete idea for CRUSH, so I have put one together.

Egypt as a stage: three settings for a CRUSH evening where art, music and a luxury brand meet. A dinner facing the Pyramids at sunset, an evening at the Grand Egyptian Museum, or a long table by the sea in El Gouna. CRUSH leads the artists and the creative; NOYA runs the venues, permits, hospitality and logistics on the ground.
Would twenty minutes next week work to talk it through?
